children: News Release Highlights:

Battery X Metals attended X Takeover 2026, an independently organized electric vehicle and emerging technology community event held at Tesla's Gigafactory Texas in Austin, Texas. The event brought together enthusiasts, entrepreneurs, and industry participants for programming on electric mobility, energy, robotics, artificial intelligence and space technology, including presentations from notable automotive and technology industry figures.

Battery X Metals engaged with electric vehicle and technology community participants, exchanging perspectives with industry participants on emerging trends, customer needs and battery technology developments to gather insights relevant to the Company's battery lifecycle technologies initiatives.

Participation supports the Company's ongoing development of its patent-pending lithium-ion battery rebalancing technology, an integrated hardware and software platform focused on addressing battery cell imbalance, improving remaining usable battery capacity and potentially extending battery lifespan. Through industry engagement, the Company seeks to understand market developments, identify potential technology applications, and evaluate opportunities relevant to its long-term objectives.

X Takeover is not an official Tesla event, and the provision of venue space does not imply sponsorship, partnership or endorsement by Tesla.4 Battery X Metals' attendance does not represent or imply any commercial agreement, partnership, endorsement or affiliation with Tesla or the event organizers, venue operator, speakers or other event participants.

X Takeover originated in 2021 as Tesla Takeover, a community gathering organized by TOSV, Inc., an independent nonprofit organization representing a community of Tesla owners and enthusiasts.2,3 The event subsequently evolved into X Takeover, expanding its focus to include electric vehicles, energy and emerging technologies. The event featured programming focused on electric mobility, energy, robotics, artificial intelligence and space technology, along with exhibitor showcases, panel discussions, demo drives, creator meetups and community experiences.4

The event featured presentations by automotive engineering expert Sandy Munro, Elon Musk, Franz von Holzhausen, and Eric Earley.4 These program references describe the event and do not indicate that Company representatives met with or held discussions with the named individuals.

Battery X Metals attended X Takeover as part of its ongoing efforts to remain engaged with developments across the electric vehicle, battery technology and broader innovation sectors. During the event, Company representatives interacted with members of the electric mobility and technology communities, exchanging perspectives on industry trends, customer needs and potential applications relevant to the Company's battery lifecycle technology initiatives.

The Company is currently advancing its patent-pending lithium-ion battery rebalancing technology, an integrated hardware and software platform focused on addressing battery cell imbalance, improving remaining usable battery capacity and potentially extending the remaining useful lifespan of lithium-ion batteries.

"X Takeover brought together a diverse community of electric vehicle enthusiasts, technology participants and entrepreneurs focused on developments across electric mobility and emerging technologies," said Will Fan, President of Battery X Metals. "As we continue to advance our patent-pending lithium-ion battery rebalancing technology, participating in these events provides an opportunity to better understand market needs, exchange perspectives with industry participants and identify developments that may be relevant to our long-term objectives."
For additional information regarding X Takeover, please visit the event's official website: www.xtakeover.com.
1 Tesla, 2 XTakeover, 3 Basenore, 4 XTakeover
About Battery X Metals Inc.
Battery X Metals

is an energy transition resource exploration and technology company committed to advancing domestic battery and critical metal resource exploration and developing next-generation proprietary technologies. Taking a diversified, 360° approach to the battery metals industry, the Company focuses on exploration, extending the lifespan of lithium-ion batteries, and the recovery and recycling of battery materials. As global electric vehicle adoption continues to grow and demand for battery lifecycle solutions increases, the Company is advancing its patent-pending lithium-ion battery rebalancing technology, which recovered approximately 99% of capacity lost due to cell imbalance in a technology demonstration conducted in collaboration with the National Research Council of Canada (NRC), with the NRC validating the initial and final state of charge of the cells. For more information, visit batteryxmetals.com.
